categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Serum Bio-Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the biopharmaceutical sector focusing on antiserum and antitoxin products. Its main business includes research, development, production, and sales of antiserum and antitoxin drugs such as equine tetanus immune globulin (F(ab')2), various snake venom antiserums, and rabies antiserum. The company also develops rapid diagnostic reagents related to snake venom detection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biotechnological methods including toxin proteomics research, antigen purification, adjuvant development, immunization and single plasma collection technology, efficient virus inactivation, pepsin digestion process optimization, column chromatography purification, and antitoxin potency detection techniques. These proprietary technologies enable the production of safe, effective, and stable emergency treatment antiserum products with improved purity and reduced allergic reactions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are healthcare providers and hospitals treating patients with snake bites, tetanus infections, and rabies exposure. The company serves the medical and emergency treatment markets in China, providing essential drugs for acute poisoning and infectious disease prevention and treatment. Its products are included in national essential drug lists and medical insurance catalogs, indicating broad clinical use.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Shanghai and a subsidiary in Jiangsu province. It has a nationwide marketing and academic promotion network covering major regions in China. There is limited overseas sales, accounting for a small portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Serum Bio-Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It controls the entire production process from horse immunization and plasma collection (upstream input) through to manufacturing and sales of finished biopharmaceutical products. The company owns a subsidiary dedicated to horse immunization and plasma collection, ensuring control over key raw materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing new product development in antiserum and rapid diagnostic reagents for biological toxins. Key R&D projects include clinical trials for new antivenoms (e.g., pit viper and bee venom antiserums) and rapid snake venom detection kits. It also invests in process improvements for existing products like rabies antiserum and tetanus immune globulin. The company aims to expand product lines, improve safety and efficacy, and enhance market penetration through academic promotion and emergency drug networks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of biopharmaceutical drugs, including antiserum and immune globulin products. Sales are conducted mainly via a distribution model supported by a professional academic promotion team that educates healthcare providers on product use. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position, especially as the sole producer of certain antivenom serums in China. It competes with a few other domestic producers in the antitoxin and immune globulin market segments, such as those producing tetanus antitoxin and rabies immune globulin. Its products are recognized for advanced technology and clinical efficacy, maintaining a competitive edge in the specialized antiserum field.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 194.9 million, a 2.51% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 44.29 million, up 14.23%. The company maintains stable total assets around RMB 1.12 billion and net assets of RMB 1.10 billion. It has shown steady growth in sales volume and profitability, supported by increased market coverage and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique position as the exclusive domestic producer of key antivenom serums, offering safe, effective, and economically accessible emergency treatment drugs. Its products have advanced to the fourth generation of antiserum technology, featuring higher purity and lower allergic reaction rates. The company’s integrated R&D, production, and nationwide academic promotion capabilities provide differentiated clinical value and competitive advantages in the biotoxin treatment and biological safety fields.
